description_en: Queries messages on a device within a specific period of time. If a message is not sent or received as expected, you can call this operation to query the messaging status of the message to efficiently troubleshoot issues
description_zh: 查询指定设备在一定时间段内的消息列表。当消息的收发不符合预期时，您可以通过该接口查看消息的收发状态等轨迹信息，帮助您快速定位异常原因
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt query-mqtt-trace-message-of-client --mqtt-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id mqtt-cn-i7m26mf0000 --client-id GID_test@@@producer --begin-time 1618646400000 --end-time 1621591200000 --current-page 1 --page-size 5 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMqttTraceMessageOfClient

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181438.html
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例地域（Region）的ID。请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181438.html
parameters.name: mqtt_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance. The ID must be consistent with the ID of the instance that the ApsaraMQ for MQTT client uses. You can view the instance ID in the Basic Information section of the Instance Details page that corresponds to the instance in the ApsaraMQ for MQTT console
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的ID，一定要和客户端实际使用的实例ID匹配。您可以在控制台实例详情页面的基础信息区域查看
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The client ID of the device whose messages you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询消息列表的设备的Client ID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value of this parameter is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的起始时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value of this parameter is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询范围的终止时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. If the input parameter value is greater than the total number of pages, the returned result is empty
parameters.help_zh: 当前取第几页消息，从1开始递增。若输入参数大于总页数，则返回结果为空
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询，每页最多显示的消息数量，最小1条，最多100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the returned results are displayed in reverse chronological order. Valid values:

true: The returned results are displayed in reverse order of the time when messages are sent or received. This means that the latest sent or received message is displayed as the first entry and the earliest sent or received message is displayed as the last entry.
false: The returned results are displayed in order of the time when messages are sent or received. This means that the earliest sent or received message is displayed as the first entry and the latest sent or received message is displayed as the last entry.

If this parameter is not specified, the returned results are displayed in order of the time when messages are sent or received
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果是否倒序显示。取值说明如下：

true：按照消息发送或消费时间倒序显示，最后一条发送或消费的消息显示在第一条，最早一条发送或消费的消息显示在最后一条。

false：按照消息发送或消费时间顺序显示，最早一条发送或消费的消息显示在第一条，最后一条发送或消费的消息显示在最后一条。

若不输入，则返回结果默认按照消息发送或消费的时间顺序显示
parameters.name: reverse

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page

Action.description_en:
The action on the message. Valid values:

pub_mqtt: The ApsaraMQ for MQTT client sends the message.
sub: The ApsaraMQ for MQTT client subscribes to the message.
push_offline: The ApsaraMQ for MQTT broker pushes the offline message to the ApsaraMQ for MQTT client
Action.description_zh:
消息动作。取值说明如下：

pub_mqtt：微消息队列MQTT版客户端发送消息。

sub：微消息队列MQTT版客户端订阅消息。

push_offline：服务端推送离线消息到微消息队列MQTT版客户端。

ServerPush：推送至云端消费

ActionCode.description_en:
The returned code for the action on the message. Valid values:

mqtt.trace.action.msg.pub.mqtt: This value is returned if the value of Action is pub_mqtt.
mqtt.trace.action.msg.sub: This value is returned if the value of Action is sub.
mqtt.trace.action.msg.push.offline: This value is returned if the value of Action is push_offline
ActionCode.description_zh:
消息动作的返回码。取值说明如下

mqtt.trace.action.msg.pub.mqtt：消息动作取值为pub_mqtt时返回该参数值。

mqtt.trace.action.msg.sub：消息动作取值为sub时返回该参数值。

mqtt.trace.action.msg.push.offline：消息动作取值为push_offline时返回该参数值。

mqtt.trace.action.server.push：消息动作取值为ServerPush时返回该参数值

ActionInfo.description_en:
The information returned for the action on the message. Valid values:

Pub From Mqtt Client: This value is returned if the value of Action is pub_mqtt.
Push To Mqtt Client: This value is returned if the value of Action is sub.
Push Offline Msg To Mqtt Client: This value is returned if the value of Action is push_offline
ActionInfo.description_zh:
消息动作的返回信息。取值说明如下：

Pub From Mqtt Client：消息动作取值为pub_mqtt时返回该参数值。

Push To Mqtt Client：消息动作取值为sub时返回该参数值。

Push Offline Msg To Mqtt Client：消息动作取值为push_offline时返回该参数值。

Server Push：消息动作取值为ServerPush时返回该参数值

ClientId.description_en: The client ID of the device

Time.description_en: The time when the message was sent or received
Time.description_zh: 消息发送的时间或被消费的时间

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页最多显示的消息数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues. This parameter is a common parameter
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题

Total.description_en: The total number of messages returned
